Title: Shop is reachable and shows the sign-in page
Steps: Open the shop home page -> Sign-in page is displayed with title Demo Shop

Title: Demo user can sign in and see the catalog
Steps: Sign in as demo / demo123 -> Product catalog is displayed

Title: Valid user can sign in
Steps: Open the sign-in page -> Form is displayed || Enter demo / demo123 and submit -> Products page opens with Hello Demo User

Title: Wrong password shows an error
Steps: Enter demo / wrong-password and submit -> Error Invalid username or password is shown and user stays on sign-in

Title: User can log out
Steps: Sign in as demo -> Products page opens || Click Log out -> Sign-in page is displayed

Title: Protected pages redirect to sign-in
Steps: Open the cart page without signing in -> User is redirected to the sign-in page

Title: Catalog lists all products with prices
Steps: Sign in -> 6 products are listed || Check the first product -> Price is $25.00

Title: Search filters products by name
Steps: Type key in the search box -> Only Mechanical Keyboard is listed

Title: Search with no match shows an empty state
Steps: Type toaster in the search box -> No products listed and an empty-state message is shown

Title: Cart badge shows the total quantity
Steps: Add Wireless Mouse twice and USB-C Hub once -> Cart badge shows 3

Title: Changing quantity updates the subtotal
Steps: Add Wireless Mouse and open the cart -> Quantity is 1 || Click + -> Quantity is 2 and subtotal is $50.00

Title: Removing the last item empties the cart
Steps: Add Mechanical Keyboard and open the cart -> Item is listed || Click Remove -> Your cart is empty is shown

Title: Promo code SAVE10 gives 10% off
Steps: Add the 27 inch Monitor and open the cart -> Subtotal is $249.00 || Apply promo code save10 -> Discount is $24.90 and total is $224.10

Title: Unknown promo code is rejected
Steps: Apply promo code FREESTUFF -> Invalid promo code is shown and discount stays $0.00

Title: Empty checkout form shows validation errors
Steps: Go to checkout and click Place order with an empty form -> 3 validation errors are shown and no order is placed

Title: Valid order shows a confirmation
Steps: Fill name / email / address and place the order -> Confirmation page shows an ORD-xxxxxx number and total $59.00

Title: Cart is empty after placing an order
Steps: Place a valid order -> Cart badge shows 0
